findings.finding: Current publisher offers full score and twelve distinct parts, about 4:50, revised 2012. Composer-version without backing; all twelve players have soloistic roles. Its 2006 arrangement date conflicts with the dated 2001 review and should not be copied.
Contemporaneous review documents Kunzelmann 2000 edition, theme, two variations and coda; D, E-flat and E major tonal progression; advanced techniques and bravura shared by all players.
Fresh yt-dlp inspection: OPUS upload, complete available description and all supplied credits inspected; dated 27 June 2018 LOTTE concert by Twelve Cellists, 276 seconds, public and embeddable.

grade.basis: All twelve cellos share exposed bravura material. Independent pedagogical estimate from publisher composer-description and contemporary review of the edition: twelve equal soloists, technical effects, tonal shifts and tight bossa-nova coordination suggest diploma-level ensemble demands. No notation inspected; this is not a measured range audit.

recordingDecisions.reason: Exact publisher-linked twelve-cello work; concert description credits the cello ensemble only. No excluded performer appears anywhere in title/channel/full description/credits. Single-work title and 276-second duration support completeness. grade.basis: Cello I, with upper-position work also in II and III. Provisional independent estimate from documented thumb-position demands and unequal solo/accompaniment roles; no score excerpt could be inspected (IMSLP redirect blocked). Whole-work tempo profile and first-part technical density remain unverified; hold numeric/style approval pending notation inspection.

findings.finding: Publisher confirms 1980 composition, six cello parts plus score, approximately 4:45, in stock. No backing required. Page labels 2012 first edition; retain historical Kunzelmann 2000 distinction.
Review of 2000 edition describes first cello carrying the dance melody, five accompanying voices, and exposed sixth-cello rhythm beneath sustained coda; calls it manageable at intermediate level.

Fresh metadata confirms fund upload, six named players and 14 March 2021 presentation concert; 358 seconds. Full description inspected; no excluded credits. Longer duration not independently resolved.

grade.basis: Cello I; cello VI must sustain the coda dance pulse. Independent pedagogical estimate from contemporary edition review: intermediate solo-led writing with syncopation, independent dance pulse and exposed sustained ensemble intonation. Early-advanced ensemble rating allows coordination demands beyond the notes. Score preview could not be opened; key therefore left unsure.

workCorrections.notes: Six independent cello parts; first cello principally carries the melody.
